reward_formula.interpretation: Own observed peak can make low and high absolute throughput yield identical normalized state and reward. This is inherited source semantics, not a newly introduced arithmetic bug. It does not prove a unique training root cause or global impossibility.

empirical.limitation: Seed denotes frozen repetition, not training seed. Pairs are independent connections with paired cfg seeds, not identical TCP randomness. reward_mean is decision-weighted; it is not time-integrated utility, true Q, or a causal counterfactual. Multiplying mean reward by mean peak would not reconstruct mean unnormalized utility.

training_bias.interpretation: At saturated negative output, current Gaussian noise gives extremely little neutral/increase support. This is inherited exploration, not proof of permanent collapse: actor gradients and generalization can still move the policy. Sparse saved checks do not identify the exact first update or uninterrupted bias duration.
